mapper.select: /* AppLeaveFlowMapper.selectApplicableLeaveTypes */ SELECT T.LEAVE_CD AS leaveCd , T.LEAVE_NM AS leaveNm , T.SYSTEM_YN AS systemYn , T.APRV_USE_YN AS typeAprvUseYn , T.USE_UNIT_TYPE AS useUnitType , CASE WHEN T.LEAVE_TYPE = '01' THEN IFNULL(T.MAX_APLY_DAYS, 0) - IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(U.LEAVE_DAYS) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE U WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = T.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND U.LEAVE_CD = T.LEAVE_CD AND U.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND U.START_DATE >= #{fiscalStartYmd} AND U.START_DATE < #{fiscalEndYmdExclusive} ), 0) ELSE IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(G.GRANT_DAYS) - SUM(G.USED_DAYS) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = T.CMPNY_CD AND G.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND G.LEAVE_CD = T.LEAVE_CD AND G.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND G.EXPIRE_YN = 'N' AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' ), 0) END AS balanceDays , T.EVIDENCE_YN AS evidenceYn , T.EVIDENCE_GUIDE_MSG AS evidenceGuideMsg FROM TB_LEAVE_TYPE_MGMT T WHERE T.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY T.SYSTEM_YN DESC, T.LEAVE_NO ASC, T.LEAVE_CD ASC

/* AppLeaveFlowMapper.selectCompanyUsageUnit */ SELECT UP.USAGE_UNIT AS usageUnit , P.APRV_USE_YN AS policyAprvUseYn FROM TB_LEAVE_POLICY P JOIN TB_LEAVE_USAGE_POLICY UP ON UP.POLICY_SEQ = P.POLICY_SEQ WHERE P.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY P.POLICY_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1

/* AppLeaveFlowMapper.selectMultiDayLeaveDayRows */ WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS ( SELECT STR_TO_DATE(#{fromYmd}, '%Y%m%d') AS dt UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_range WHERE DATE_ADD(dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) <= STR_TO_DATE(#{toYmd}, '%Y%m%d') ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.dt, '%Y%m%d') AS ymd , CASE DAYOFWEEK(d.dt) WHEN 1 THEN '일' WHEN 2 THEN '월' WHEN 3 THEN '화' WHEN 4 THEN '수' WHEN 5 THEN '목' WHEN 6 THEN '금' WHEN 7 THEN '토' END AS dow , CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(d.dt) IN (1, 7) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS weekendYn , CASE WHEN h.HOLIDAY_YMD IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS holidayYn , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USER_WORK_PLAN WP WHERE WP.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND WP.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND WP.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND WP.WORK_YMD = DATE_FORMAT(d.dt, '%Y%m%d') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_SCH_MGMT S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND S.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND S.SCH_CD = WP.WORK_PLAN_CD ) ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS hasScheduleYn , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_USER_ATTD_MGMT A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND A.WORK_YMD = DATE_FORMAT(d.dt, '%Y%m%d') AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS attdCnt , ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN U.USE_UNIT_TYPE = '00' THEN 1.0 ELSE U.LEAVE_DAYS END ), 0) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE U WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND U.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND U.START_DATE <= DATE_FORMAT(d.dt, '%Y%m%d') AND U.END_DATE >= DATE_FORMAT(d.dt, '%Y%m%d') ) AS occupiedDays FROM date_range d LEFT JOIN TB_HOLIDAY h ON h.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND h.HOLIDAY_YMD = DATE_FORMAT(d.dt, '%Y%m%d') AND h.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY d.dt ASC
/* AppLeaveFlowMapper.selectNextLeaveGroupId */ SELECT CONCAT('LG', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), FNC_CMM_SEQ_NEXTVAL(#{cmpnyCd}, 'LEAVE_GROUP_ID')) FROM DUAL
/* AppLeaveFlowMapper.selectNextReqId */ SELECT CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), FNC_CMM_SEQ_NEXTVAL(#{cmpnyCd}, 'ATTD_REQ_ID')) FROM DUAL
/* AppLeaveFlowMapper.selectNextLeaveId */ SELECT CONCAT('LV', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), FNC_CMM_SEQ_NEXTVAL(#{cmpnyCd}, 'LEAVE_USE_ID')) FROM DUAL

/* AppLeaveFlowMapper.selectLeaveTypeInfo */ SELECT A.SYSTEM_YN AS systemYn , A.APRV_USE_YN AS aprvUseYn , A.USE_UNIT_TYPE AS useUnitType , A.LEAVE_TYPE AS leaveType , A.MAX_APLY_DAYS AS maxAplyDays , A.AVAIL_TERM_TYPE AS availTermType , A.EVIDENCE_YN AS evidenceYn FROM TB_LEAVE_TYPE_MGMT A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.LEAVE_CD = #{leaveCd} LIMIT 1

/* AppLeaveFlowMapper.getAdvisoryLock */
SELECT GET_LOCK(MD5(#{lockKey}), #{timeoutSec})
/* AppLeaveFlowMapper.releaseAdvisoryLock */ SELECT RELEASE_LOCK(MD5(#{lockKey}))
/* AppLeaveFlowMapper.selectPolicyAprvUseYn */ SELECT P.APRV_USE_YN FROM TB_LEAVE_POLICY P WHERE P.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY P.POLICY_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1

/* AppLeaveFlowMapper.selectUserNodeSelfApproveYn */ SELECT N.SELF_ATTD_APPRV_YN FROM TB_USER U JOIN TB_SITE_NODE N ON N.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND N.SITE_CD = U.SITE_CD AND N.NODE_CD = U.NODE_CD WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND N.SELF_ATTD_APPRV_YN = 'Y' AND (N.MAIN_ADMIN_CD = U.USER_CD OR N.SUB_ADMIN_CD = U.USER_CD) LIMIT 1

/* AppLeaveFlowMapper.selectReqIdByEvidenceFileId */ SELECT U.REQ_ID FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE U JOIN TB_FILE_INFO F ON F.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND F.FILE_MGMT_CD = U.EVIDENCE_FILE_ID AND F.FILE_TYPE = '008' WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.EVIDENCE_FILE_ID = #{fileMgmtCd} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' LIMIT 1
